description: This file contains a utility function `makeAzurePath` for constructing Azure service endpoint paths by modifying the input `path` string to remove a version prefix and append an `api-version` query parameter.

methods.name: export function makeAzurePath(path: string, apiVersion: string) { makeAzurePath
methods.description: Constructs an Azure API path by removing '/v1/' prefix and appending the 'api-version' query parameter.
